BiblicalUsage: Shuach was a son of Abraham by Keturah, his concubine, named among Zimran and Jokshan and Medan and Midian and Ishbak. He is the ancestor of the Shuhites, and his name is carried in the genealogies of Genesis and Chronicles alike.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Abraham's later sons are still Abraham's sons. Shuach never inherited the promise, but his name is kept, and I hold that God remembers every branch of the family He chose.
